name: chlaude-gptopus-desktop
description: Delegate text-only tasks from Claude Desktop Chat to six OpenAI workers, with two separate API keys and persistent daily-usage guardrails. Per-worker reasoning effort ranges and guidance.
long_description: OpenAI worker tools for the regular Claude Desktop Chat tab. Uses the OpenAI Responses API, separate straight/free API key profiles, configurable Flex/Fast tiers and local Astra/Terra token-usage ledgers. For file and shell access, use the native Claude Code plugin in Desktop's Code tab instead.

straight_api_key.title: Straight OpenAI API key
straight_api_key.description: Used by sol, astra, luna and flex6-1. Leave empty on Windows to reuse the key saved by Chlaude-GPTopus CLI setup, if available.

free_api_key.title: Free-programme OpenAI API key
free_api_key.description: Used only by daily-astrafree and daily-terrafree. Leave empty on Windows to reuse the existing DPAPI free key, if available.
